_comment: The cognition engine's authored content (see docs/design/PROCESSING-MODEL.md). OBSERVABLES hold objective reading TIERS (deterministic: deepest tier whose unlock_when you meet; no roll) and an authored VALUE = how much noticing this matters (the one authored worth knob). THOUGHTS are subjective: a self-scaling ROLL, recorded once. Their VALUE (consequence a thought sets in motion), DIFFICULTY (structural + a quiet value nudge), and Spirit EXP are all DERIVED at load -- never author difficulty or spirit_exp. A hidden observable carries visible_when; a thought's set_flag can reveal it, which is how VALUE flows forward. World: 32px tiles, region 48x48, spawn (768,768).

add.label: Clear the moss from its face
add.result_text: The moss comes away in a wet green sheet, and the stone shows its grain.

tiers.text: A stone, half-sunk in the grass.
A cap of moss clings to its north face.
Beside it, an anthill worn low into the earth.
A dry channel in the earth. A stream ran here.
How quiet it is, out here.
The quiet has a shape. Something stood here and was glad of it.

observables._comment: HIDDEN until people_lived_here reveals it (visible_when the knows_settlement flag). High value -- this is what makes people_lived_here a consequential (rare) conclusion. Placed near the dry channel.

tiers.text: Fieldstone, squared by hand. A threshold, once.
A hearth-stone among them, scorched black. Someone kept a fire here.

thoughts._comment: THOUGHT: one observation. Simple structure -> low difficulty. Opens nothing -> low value/reward.
thoughts.text: Worn smooth. Water shaped it, once, where none runs now.
thoughts.miss_text: There is something about the stone's shape you can't place.

thoughts._comment: THOUGHT: one observation, opens nothing. Common, easy.
thoughts.text: A held breath of a place. You could stay here a while.
thoughts.miss_text: The clearing tugs at you, faintly.

thoughts._comment: ACTION-GATED THOUGHT: needs the moss cleared (the clear_moss action's flag). Demonstrates a deed unlocking a thought -- and the way back to one you couldn't reach by looking alone.
thoughts.text: Under the moss: faint chisel-marks. Not weather. A hand shaped this, long ago.
thoughts.miss_text: The grain of the stone seems almost deliberate, but you can't be sure.

thoughts._comment: CONCLUSION: series (stone AND water), feeders, and it REVEALS the ruin (value 8) -> high VALUE, big reward. Difficulty is structural (breadth 2 + 1 feeder) with a quiet value nudge.
thoughts.text: People lived here once. The water drew them; the water left.

thoughts._comment: PAYOFF CONCLUSION: needs the revealed ruin AND the prior conclusion. Terminal (opens nothing -> opening 0), but valuable via UPSTREAM centrality (the whole stone/water/ruin pyramid led here). emotional_weight is the authored dial for the beat a graph can't feel -- this is the quiet gut-punch the wood was building toward.
thoughts.text: They did not leave in haste. They banked the fire, and walked out, and did not come back.
thoughts.miss_text: The hearth-stone holds a question you can't yet read.
